title: Mutual aid agreement to help Kauaʻi after Hurricane Lowell
summary: On October 23, the Council postponed County Communication 26-28, a proposed amendment to Bill 124, until it takes up that bill. Bill 124 would let Maui County help the County of Kauaʻi respond to and recover from Hurricane Lowell. It passed eight to zero on September 29, with one member excused.

timeline.text: Eight members, with one excused, backed a bill to send help to Kauaʻi after Hurricane Lowell.
A council member said Maui wants to help Kauaʻi because of the help Kauaʻi gave after the fire.
The agreement does not require Maui County to send staff or resources it does not have or needs.
A bill would let Maui County help the County of Kauaʻi respond to and recover from a hurricane.
